AirPro Diagnostics, LLC | First lien senior secured delayed draw term loan | Principal/Par Amount 3,163 | Amortized Cost 8 | Fair Value 13

findings.detail: X06 treats source-correct principal amounts on revolving and delayed-draw commitments as errors solely because fair value is less than one-tenth of principal.

rationale: Class 1 source checks confirm the flagged principal values are faithfully extracted from the March 31, 2026 schedule. The schedule explicitly reports principal 3,557 versus fair value 350 for a revolving loan and principal 3,163 versus fair value 13 for a delayed draw term loan. These low fair values on commitment-style instruments make the greater-than-10x ratio real but do not make the principal erroneous; the defect is X06 rule scope, not the data. Residual risk is that the other 11 flagged rows were not individually cited, although the item-level pattern and two directly matching flagged values establish the mechanism.
